_: Scenes for `pnpm shots` (scripts/shots.mjs). Add your own: a scene is data, no code.
query    URL params merged over `defaults.query`; a null value removes a default. These are the game's own hooks
(src/debug.ts): seed, warp (sim days before the first frame), speed (0 = paused), hour, zoom, focus=x,z,
viewport 'WxH' (default 1440x900). mobile: true = a phone: dsf 2, touch (use with 390x844). dsf: 2 = a 2x (retina) desktop capture.
steps    run in order once the page has drawn `frames` frames (default 24), then it settles again and shoots:
{ "select": "researcher" | "researcher:Ada Gradient" }   tap a walker (opens the inspector)
{ "type": "text", "into": "css selector", "enter": true }       fill a field (FLT-63: the Run box)
{ "drag": [[x, z], ...], "hold": true }                       a real mouse drag over tiles; hold = button still down
storage  { key: value } put in localStorage before the page loads (a returning player's saved pick, e.g. "flt.skin").
ready    a JS expression that is true once the page is ready to shoot (default: the game's World is up). FLT-95's box scenes use `!!window.__intro`.
sets     named lists for --scenes (`standard` is the default; `all` is every scene).
